q2tA.text: [uneasy] While he chanted, the smoke kept leaning toward a covered jar, and the cloth over it moved by itself. His shadow moved a moment after he did. And I saw someone standing behind him... I looked again, and there was no one.

q2B1.text: [hopeful] Lersi Chin... will you teach me? I feel things, and sometimes I cannot control my body. I don't know why.

a.heard: Lersi Chin... will you teach me? I feel things, and sometimes I cannot control my body. I don't know why.

lc2B1.text: [gentle] Why you feel, why your body moves without you... what it is for. That question is bigger than my practice. I clear. I cannot answer that one.

lc2B2.text: [gentle] Someone can teach you. Not me. When you find him, don't take my word. Don't take Pong's word. Check his teacher. Check his people. Then go.
